description: Release gate policy for the Playwright suite (tools\release\Test-WaReleasePreflight.ps1). Every skipped test must be listed for the asset mode the pass runs in, with a reason; any other skip fails the gate, and so does a listed test that ran or no longer exists. The pass must also run at least minimumTests tests (raise it when tests are added, lower it only on purpose). Test keys are '<spec file> > <describe titles> > <test title>'.

expectedSkips.test: pro-assets.spec.js > Pro components upgrade when a Pro asset override is active
expectedSkips.reason: guards the Pro asset delivery chain, so it runs only with a Pro asset override (the opt-in Pro pass, -ProDist)

expectedSkips.test: value-sync-binding.spec.js > value sync: WaDateInput reflects C# model change after user edit
expectedSkips.reason: wa-date-input is a Pro component and never upgrades from the free CDN; the opt-in Pro pass (-ProDist) runs it
